card.name: The word per inside dose rates
card.fires_on: The word "per" (or a slash) right after a dose or volume unit such as mg or mL, where a rate or concentration follows (mg per mL, mL per minute).

modes.label: Per after a unit
modes.description: "per" follows mg or mL and introduces the denominator of a concentration or infusion rate.
modes.example: a maximum levetiracetam concentration of 15 mg<< per>> mL of diluted solution.

modes.label: Slash or bracket after a unit
modes.description: A slash or opening parenthesis after a dose unit introduces an equivalent amount or alternate unit.
